description: This file defines a PHP class 'Language' within the OrangeHRM project, specifically in the reporting display fields for language-related data. It extends a listable display field and specifies DTO class, entity alias, and fields related to language display in reports.

classes.name: Language
classes.description: Represents a report display field for language data, extending functionality for listable display fields within the reporting system.

methods.name: getDtoClass
methods.description: Returns the class name of the Data Transfer Object (DTO) associated with this display field.

methods.name: getEntityAliases
methods.description: Provides the entity aliases used in constructing report queries.

methods.name: getFields
methods.description: Specifies the database fields related to this display field.
